items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, I think of Warnick and T.O. and, uh, Ninn... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, but he was one of the best jazz ones too around then.

ctx.x: He also was with, on the same recording with, with, he used to be with Pichon, not Pichon, Piron, A.J. Piron. And he also, well, he was one of the better musicians around.
You know, I think of Warnick and T.O. and, uh, Ninn, but this guy was a reader, huh?
Yeah, but he was one of the best jazz ones too around then.
